description: The baseline policy, written out here rather than inherited.

github>unional/renovate-preset is currently {"extends": ["config:base", ":preserveSemverRanges"]} and carries none of this — no automerge, no release-age soak, no packageRules. Extending it would open PRs that never merge. Collapse this back to that preset once it actually publishes the policy.

packageRules.description: Majors break builds in ways CI catches but a human should choose to absorb.
